alive.last_commit_message:
Show Core's live queue position, quiet hidden terminal and subagent polls, and keep operator message actions reachable (#583)

* Show Core's live queue position, quiet hidden polls and keep operator message actions reachable

- streamChat maps Core's queued/admitted frames, so "Waiting for Core
  capacity · position N" updates while a turn waits and clears when Core
  admits it. The first queued frame is held 400 ms inside the stream: a free
  slot admits a turn within milliseconds, so a turn that starts at once never
  shows a queue position. A started frame also clears a leftover wait.
- ContainerTerminalPanel reads terminal audit health through startVisiblePoll
  only while the terminal is shown: 0 reads behind the chat and in a hidden
  tab (21/min each before), one read on return, then every 3 s.
- GET /chat/sessions/{id}/subagents sends a content ETag and answers 304 when
  unchanged; the subagent rail sends If-None-Match and keeps its list.
- Operator rows keep their out-of-bubble time and actions unclipped
  (content-visibility paint containment clipped them since aa05f0f), and a
  short bubble's actions stay one row instead of a column over the reply.
- The queued-message and in-place message editors opt out of the
  selected-text toolbar, which covered "Save queued edit" on WebKit phones.
- Tests: App.test mocks the credential status check #548 added; the two
  full-App vitest cases get the 15 s budget CI already uses.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: record the focused test selection for ui-leftovers

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Keep icon artwork in place when its parent renders again

Every icon passed dangerouslySetInnerHTML a new object per render, and
React 19 rewrites innerHTML whenever that object changes, so each render
of a transcript row rebuilt the paths of all its action icons. App.test's
"keeps chat drafts durable..." asserts that typing leaves the transcript
DOM alone; whenever a row re-rendered while it typed (an async read
landing), those rewrites failed it (7/10 runs alone on main, the frontend
CI failure here). The markup object is now memoized on its body.

The same test also asserted the Archived group's expansion synchronously,
before the effect that opens it for the selected conversation had run, and
gave the first lazy Workbench lookup 5 s; it now waits for the expansion
and allows 10 s within its 15 s budget.
